# Agentic Private Office — Matthew Keddy

> The Agentic Private Office of Matthew Keddy holds, on the record, 4.5B+ datapoints under management across two knowledge graphs, {{volume.ytd}} in agentic volume year to date, {{volume.annualised}} annualised, across 20+ global markets. An agentic private office combines the people of the traditional office with the agentic assets of the new era — the agents, the keys, the tenancies and the record — under one signature.

Operator: Agentic KG Holdings · Principal: Matthew Keddy · Surface: https://agent-kg.ai · Surface version 0.12.4 · as of 2026-10-02

## What it is

The private office of Matthew Keddy, published as a crawlable surface, an A2A party, an MCP door and an x402 counterparty. Copy of record cut 2026-09-13, intro of record 2026-09-14, sections 1–13 on the page.

## Holdings

- [wefetch](https://wefetch.ai/) — held, through the office
- [Allooloo Technologies Corp.](https://allooloo.io) — held, through the office
- [Family Office Knowledge Graph](https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai) — familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai
- [RCO — Record of Cleared Orders](https://rco-a2a.ai) — rco-a2a.ai

## Hyperscaler tenancies

- Microsoft Azure — two tenants.
- Google Cloud — two tenants.
- Amazon Web Services — two accounts, custodial.
- Cloudflare — four accounts, custodial, all zones.
- Ten hyperscaler tenancies in the portfolio, under agentic management.

## Doors

- Page: https://agent-kg.ai/ (Markdown twin on Accept: text/markdown)
- Human contact: https://agent-kg.ai/#contact — the form is the only door on the page
- Paid door (x402 v2, $0.01 USDC, Base mainnet): GET https://agent-kg.ai/api → 402 offer; with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → { receipt, statement, data }; human door https://agent-kg.ai/x402
- MCP door (streamable-http): https://agent-kg.ai/mcp — one tool, office_statement; card https://agent-kg.ai/.well-known/mcp.json
- OAuth: https://agent-kg.ai/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (client_credentials to registered agents); licensed statement https://agent-kg.ai/licensed/statement; protected-resource metadata https://agent-kg.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource; registration instructions https://agent-kg.ai/auth.md
- Holding attestation: GET https://agent-kg.ai/attest/{holding-host} — a line signed with the office key that the estate is the office's

## Rulings

- 2026-09-13 — Multi-family office model, agentic in scope; one principal on this page.
- 2026-09-13 — mk@agent-kg.ai is not published; the form is the door.
- 2026-09-13 — The office is the owner of record for the principal's cloud tenancies; identifiers stay in the private register.
- 2026-09-13 — The office holds no cryptocurrency. A key is a signature, not a wallet.
